finding: The read service rejected limits outside 1..50 and offsets outside 0..10000, but the FastAPI route exposed both query parameters as unbounded strings and did not publish the limits in OpenAPI.

change.behavior: FastAPI validates integer query parameters before calling the service; invalid values return 422.

rollback: Revert the Query constraints and focused contract test; no migration or persisted data changed.
limitations: Checks cover OpenAPI generation and in-process request validation only; they do not establish live proxy behavior or data authorization.
